neighbours.label: Japanese person noun + が tokens (人が, 者が, さんが) and the words ' sugar', ' privately' and 'lers' (a list)
fire: この町には親切な人が多いです。
怪しい業者が電話をかけてきた。
佐藤さんが説明してくれました。
Too much sugar harms your teeth.
The school is privately funded by donors.
The car had rusty mufflers under the frame.
Brown sugar melts quickly in hot tea.
He sold the land privately to a neighbor.
quiet: この町には親切な店が多いです。
怪しい電話がかかってきた。
佐藤さんの説明を聞きました。
Too much salt harms your teeth.
The school is largely funded by donors.
The car had rusty bumpers under the frame.
Brown rice cooks slowly in hot water.
He sold the land quickly to a neighbor.

notes: Broad (3.8% of tokens reach 0.1 of max). Plural agent nouns (retailers, teachers) did not fire in probes, so I kept the list rather than an 'agent noun' label.
